name: footer-privilege
title: Footer Privilege
description: A black footer split in two halves: a large thin "A Privilege." headline over a small logo and brand name on the left, and a dim "Beyond Reach." headline, short paragraph and contact button on the right.
use: A studio or design brand wants a stark two-column footer with oversized type and a single contact action.
avoid: The headlines, paragraph and brand name are fixed to this brand, so every footer needs a source edit.
a11y: The contact button is a real button but has no click handler, so it only changes colour; the credit link is the sole destination. (keyboard: partial, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black footer divided into two columns. Left: a large thin white headline, then a small white rounded logo tile with a dark glyph beside a bold brand name. Right: a big grey headline, a four-line grey paragraph and a charcoal rounded uppercase button. A hairline separates a small spaced copyright row along the bottom.
behaves: Nothing moves on its own. Hovering the contact button flips it from charcoal to white with black text, and the footer's colours ease if the page theme changes.
customise: Headlines, paragraph, brand name, credits and the button label are hardcoded; accent colours and the hover flip need source edits.
weight: light: A static block of type and links with colour transitions on hover only.
demo: "A Privilege." and "Beyond Reach." with Layouts Equity branding and a made-by credit.
issues: The Contact us button has no click handler and does not lead anywhere.
The secondary headline and paragraph are very dim grey on black, low contrast.
polishWhy: Bold oversized type and a clean split; the mid headline and body copy are very dim.
